one_line_description: Local alignment against the FM-index (revised BWA-SW, affine gaps), PAF output with cs/cg tags and rh hit count; options -N -A -B -O -E -m -k -j
End-to-end alignment returning several suboptimal hits (haplotype retrieval); compact all-hit format capped by -g
Haplotype diversity: for sliding 101-mers reports number of distinct alleles, max edit distance and haplotype counts at edit distance 0..6+ (-a, -w)
Regions of the query not covered by long SMEMs (BED or sequence) and total breadth of SMEM coverage
Minimum interval size (minimum occurrence count) for reported SMEMs; -l sets minimum SMEM length
Longest matching suffix of each query in the index, with start, length and hit count
Count (high-occurrence) k-mers across one or more FMD indexes by DFS over the BWT (-k, -m)
Cut overlapping k-mers (-k, step -w) from FASTX for use as queries (mappability / coverage workflows)
Convert FASTX to one sequence per line (with reverse complement) as input for grlBWT / build -L
Convert a plain-text BWT (e.g. from grlBWT) to the FMD format
Basic BWT statistics: sequences, symbols, runs, per-base counts
Retrieve the i-th indexed sequence (FASTA) from the BWT
Generate the sampled suffix array (.fmd.ssa) with sampling rate 2^s, multi-threaded
Ropebwt2-style construction in reverse-complement-lexicographic or reverse-lexicographic read order for short reads
Save the current index after each input file during incremental build
Dump the BWT in the BRE binary format
Matching statistics (lengths + pointers) of reads against a pangenome via prefix-free-parsed RLBWT, SA samples and thresholds
MEM extension with ksw2 into SAM alignments (-L ref window, -A -B -O -E scoring, -b batch)
Builds RLBWT with SA samples at run boundaries and threshold positions (Bannai-Gagie-I) via pfp-thresholds; shaped or plain SLP grammar (-g)
Streamed matching statistics with an SLP and LCE queries instead of thresholds (memory-friendly); writes .positions/.lengths
Pseudo-matching lengths: a faster MS approximation used for read classification with a null database and -c report
Minimizer digestion of the reference before PFP to shrink the index for >2 GB references
Multi-class classification of reads with a document array; filelist build assigns class ids
Binary classification of reads by PML scores; --filter emits found reads, -v the not-found reads
Multi-class / taxonomic classification using color (document) sets per move row; primary and secondary document id output
Ziv-Merhav cross-parsing length of reads versus the reference
Search every k-mer of a read in the index and report found counts
k-mer lookup table that shortcuts the first k LF steps (also needed for --mem)
Sampled suffix-array entries per read position (locate by SA sampling, --sample-rate)
Generate null reads and null PML/ZML statistics used for classification thresholds
Print base-profile-format (BPF) binary outputs of PML/ZML as text
Piecewise locate: splits a read into exact-match pieces and locates every piece (r-index fork), with --max-hits/--max-range
Phi function (SA[j-1] from SA[j]) and count with SA[r] retrieval underlying r-index locate
Run-boundary sampled suffix arrays (.ssa/.esa) or the full SA written during PFP BWT construction
Cross-check the PFP BWT against a SACA-K computed BWT
